import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_CSV_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load sample submission for template format
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)
class_names = list(sample_sub.columns.drop("id"))
num_classes = len(class_names)
print(f"Total species classes: {num_classes}")

species_to_idx = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(class_names)}
idx_to_species = {i: name for i, name in enumerate(class_names)}

# Load train/test data
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

# Identify feature columns - get all non-numeric columns except id
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != "id" and col != "species"]
X_train_full_raw = train_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
y_train_raw = train_df["species"].values


# Encode train labels
def get_idx(name):
    return species_to_idx.get(name, -1)


y_train_encoded = np.array([get_idx(y) for y in y_train_raw])

# Filter valid training entries where species exists
valid_indices = np.where(y_train_encoded != -1)[0]
y_train = y_train_encoded[valid_indices]
X_train_valid_raw = X_train_full_raw[valid_indices]

# Prepare test features (drop id)
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

# CRITICAL FIX: Apply uniform scaling to BOTH train and test data BEFORE any modeling
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_valid_raw)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

# Perform a genuine train-test split BEFORE any model fitting (genuine hold-out)
X_train_valid, X_test_holdout, y_train_valid, y_test_holdout = train_test_split(
    X_train_scaled, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)
print(f"Training shape: {X_train_valid.shape}, Holdout shape: {X_test_holdout.shape}")

# EXPANDED HYPERPARAMETER GRID FOR FINE-GRAINED REGULARIZATION SEARCH
param_grid = {
    "C": [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0, 10.0, 20.0, 50.0, 100.0],
    "max_iter": [2000, 5000, 10000],
    "solver": ["lbfgs", "liblinear"],
}

cv_folds = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=cv_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

model_base = LogisticRegression(multi_class="multinomial")
grid_search = GridSearchCV(
    model_base, param_grid, cv=skf, scoring="neg_log_loss", n_jobs=-1
)
grid_search.fit(X_train_valid, y_train_valid)

best_params = grid_search.best_params_
print(f"Best hyperparameters: {best_params}")

# Train FINAL model ONLY on training data (NO refitting on holdout/validation data)
final_model = LogisticRegression(
    solver=best_params["solver"],
    max_iter=best_params["max_iter"],
    C=best_params["C"],
    multi_class="multinomial",
)
final_model.fit(X_train_valid, y_train_valid)

# Evaluate on HOLDOUT validation set WITH CORRECT LOG-LOSS COMPUTATION
val_probs = final_model.predict_proba(X_test_holdout)
val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_test_holdout, val_probs_clipped, labels=np.arange(num_classes))
print(f"Hold-Out Validation Log-Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on PROVIDED UNLABELED TEST DATA (never seen during CV/final training)
test_preds = final_model.predict_proba(X_test_scaled)
test_rows_sum = np.sum(test_preds, axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_rows_sum_safe = np.where(test_rows_sum == 0, 1, test_rows_sum)
test_preds_rescaled = test_preds / test_rows_sum_safe
test_preds_final = np.clip(test_preds_rescaled, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Create submission dataframe with exact format from sample
sub_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["id"] + class_names)
sub_df["id"] = test_df["id"].values

for j, col_name in enumerate(class_names):
    sub_df[col_name] = test_preds_final[:, j]

# Save to required location
sub_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_CSV_PATH, index=False)

print("Submission saved successfully.")
